title: Radial bar chart
description: Progress as concentric rings: activity rings, OKR completion, sales against quota. Each bar fills its ring up to its value over its max, on a tinted background track, with rounded ends; labels sit in the open part of the circle and a center text can sum things up. Hover a ring or use the arrow keys to read its value, max and progress.

props.name: data
props.description: Bars, from the outermost ring inward: a name, a value, an optional `max` and color

props.name: max
props.description: Value of a full bar for the data without `max`

props.name: innerRadius
props.description: Radius of the innermost ring's inner edge, as a fraction of the outer radius

props.name: startAngle
props.description: Angle where the bars start, degrees clockwise from 12 o'clock

props.name: sweep
props.description: Angle of a full bar, degrees (360 = full rings)

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap between the rings, as a fraction of a ring's slot (0-0.9)

props.name: track
props.description: Background tracks behind the bars

props.name: rounded
props.description: Rounded bar ends

props.name: labels
props.description: Labels before the start of the bars (in the empty part of the circle)

props.name: labelContent
props.description: What a label shows: name, value, percent of the bar's max (combinable)

props.name: centerValue
props.description: Big text in the center (e.g. the overall completion)

props.name: centerLabel
props.description: Small text under `centerValue`

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the chart (the legend included); numbers are pixels

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the chart; numbers are pixels

props.name: renderer
props.description: Backend of the shapes: `auto` tries WebGPU, then WebGL2, then WebGL, then Canvas2D, skipping GPUs running in software; text is always drawn with Canvas2D, above the shapes

props.name: palette
props.description: Colors of the marks without `color` (defaults to the `--chart-series-1..8` CSS variables, then the theme colors)

props.name: legend
props.description: Legend; clicking an item hides / shows its slice, stage, series, node, bar, row or level

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Tooltip; `false` disables it

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the values of the labels and the tooltip

props.name: percentFormat
props.description: Formats the shares (labels, conversion rates, tooltip); `share` is 0-1

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale of the texts and numbers the chart writes (tooltip rows, accessible names, number and percent formats, calendar dates); built-in texts in English, Chinese, Japanese and French (English otherwise)

props.name: texts
props.description: Replaces built-in texts of the `locale` (tooltip rows, accessible names, "No data")

props.name: hidden
props.description: Hidden slices / stages / radar series / top-level treemap or sunburst nodes / sankey nodes / radial bars / bullet rows / calendar levels, by index. Makes the visibility controlled: legend clicks then only call `onToggle`, whose `hiddenIndexes` should be stored and passed back. Leave undefined to let the legend hide / show entries by itself.

props.name: animation
props.description: Entry and update animations (skipped when the user prefers reduced motion)

props.name: padding
props.description: Space around the drawing, in pixels

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the chart

props.name: renderTooltip
props.description: React content of the tooltip (replaces the default content)

events.name: onToggle
events.description: Called when a legend item is clicked (or the instance's `toggle()` is called), with the toggled index and every hidden index after the toggle

events.name: onHover
events.description: Called when the hovered (or keyboard-focused) mark changes

events.name: onClick
events.description: Called when a mark is clicked, tapped or activated with Enter

examples.title: Activity rings
examples.description: Full rings (sweep={360}) for Move, Exercise and Stand, each against its own daily goal (max). Picking another day animates the rings; as there is no room for labels, the legend names the rings.

examples.title: Season leaderboard
examples.description: A RadioGroup ranks the players by goals or assists; the leader takes the outermost ring and the scale, and the podium gets gold, silver and bronze through each datum's color. renderTooltip adds the rank, the games played and the average per game.

examples.title: OKR completion
examples.description: Key results in percent of their target (max={100}), labelled with their name and percent before the start of each bar; the average completion is written in the center.

examples.title: Sales against quota
examples.description: A half circle (sweep={180}, startAngle={-90}) takes half the height; each region has its own quota as max. labels={false} shows the legend instead, and the center gives the overall attainment.

examples.title: Savings goals
examples.description: Each pot has its own goal as max, and labelContent shows the name and the percent saved. onClick picks a goal: the line below gives the amount left and how many months the monthly transfer needs to reach it.

examples.title: Shapes and styles
examples.description: sweep and startAngle set the shape of the rings, rounded the ends of the bars and track the background tracks.

examples.title: Engagement survey
examples.description: Each statement's max is the number of people who answered it, so the bars show the share who agree. A Select reorders the rings by survey order or by score, percentFormat writes the percents, and renderTooltip gives the underlying counts.

examples.title: File uploads
examples.description: Full rings (sweep={360}) track four uploads, two at a time, with a setInterval that stops once everything is sent or on unmount; animation={false} keeps the bars in step with the fast updates. labels={false} lets the legend name the files, and only completed files are announced.

RadialBarChartProps.data: Bars, from the outermost ring inward: a name, a value, an optional max and color
RadialBarChartProps.max: Value of a full bar for the data without max (the largest value by default)
RadialBarChartProps.innerRadius: Radius of the innermost ring's inner edge, as a fraction of the outer radius
RadialBarChartProps.startAngle: Angle where the bars start, in degrees clockwise from 12 o'clock
RadialBarChartProps.sweep: Angle of a full bar, in degrees (360 draws full rings)
RadialBarChartProps.gap: Gap between the rings, as a fraction of a ring's slot (0 to 0.9)
RadialBarChartProps.track: Draws the background tracks behind the bars
RadialBarChartProps.rounded: Rounds the ends of the bars
RadialBarChartProps.labels: Labels before the start of the bars, in the open part of the circle (on by default when the sweep leaves room, up to 300°)
RadialBarChartProps.labelContent: What a label shows: name, value and / or percent of the bar's max
RadialBarChartProps.centerValue: Big text in the center (e.g. the overall completion)

RadialBarDatum.name: Name shown in the label, the legend and the tooltip
RadialBarDatum.value: Value of the bar (negative values count as 0)
RadialBarDatum.color: Color (any CSS color, var(--x) included); taken from the palette when omitted
RadialBarDatum.max: Value of a full bar (e.g. a goal); the chart's max when omitted

props.height: Height of the chart, the legend included: pixels or any CSS length
props.options: Other engine options (axes, legend, tooltip, palette, format…) merged with the element's own properties; property only
props.instance: The engine instance (minerva-design/charts/core), null until the element is rendered and connected

events.minerva-hover: The hovered (or keyboard-focused) mark changed; detail: { index, name, value, share }, null when nothing is hovered
events.minerva-click: A mark was clicked, tapped or activated with Enter; detail: { index, name, value, share }
events.minerva-toggle: A legend item was clicked (or toggle() called); detail: { index, hidden, hiddenIndexes }

methods.toggle: Hides / shows a slice, stage, radar series or top-level treemap node by index
methods.getRenderer: Backend drawing the shapes (webgpu, webgl2, webgl, canvas2d), null until ready; set it with the renderer engine option
